- Read improve-code-boundaries skill and restored prior context via progress_read.
- Starting inspection of tests/ha/support to find one concrete boundary smell to flatten.
- Next: map the support module tree, identify wrappers/conversions/bootstrap structs, then remove one and verify with make check / focused nextest.

- Mapped tests/ha/support and narrowed likely fake-boundary candidates around observer state wrappers.
- Spotted a separate repo-rule violation in tests/ha/support/invariants/write_convergence.rs: worker/connection errors are swallowed with let _ = ... and need a bug filed.
- Next: create the bug task, then finish selecting the single boundary layer to collapse and implement it.

- Mapped tests/ha/support and identified HarnessWorkspace in tests/ha/support/world/mod.rs as the strongest fake boundary.
- It is local-only and forces repeated self.workspace forwarding/accessors without adding invariants.
- Next: flatten HarnessWorkspace into HarnessShared, then run make check and focused nextest for world/support coverage.

- Filed bug bug-write-convergence-invariant-swallows-worker-errors.md for swallowed worker/connection errors.
- Collapsed the fake observer outcome boundary in tests/ha/support/observer/pgtm.rs by removing MemberCommandOutcome and using plain Result<T, String>; updated support consumers in steps/world.
- Next: run make check and focused cargo nextest coverage for the touched support observer area, then stage only my changes for commit despite unrelated worktree edits.

- Flattened HarnessWorkspace into HarnessShared inside tests/ha/support/world/mod.rs and updated the local constructor/call sites.
- This removes the local courier wrapper and keeps HarnessShared as the single owner of run/given/compose/materialized paths.
- Next: run cargo fmt, make check, and focused cargo nextest coverage for the touched world support tests.

- make check passed after flattening HarnessWorkspace.
- First cargo nextest invocation used the wrong filter syntax and ran zero tests; treating that as invalid and rerunning with explicit filter syntax.
- Next: run the real ha support::world test slice, confirm nonzero executed tests, then commit and task-switch.

- make check passed after finishing the in-progress HarnessShared flattening in tests/ha/support/world/mod.rs that the repo already contained.
- Focused nextest passed for host_postgres_dsn_quotes_tls_paths and two world tests covering write-convergence attachment health/cleanup.
- Next: stage only support-boundary files plus the bug task, commit, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Committed the support boundary refactor as 48fea17 Flatten ha support harness boundaries.
- Verified with make check plus focused cargo nextest runs for observer/world support tests.
- Next: execute .ralph/task_switch.sh to hand off to the next Ralph task.
